raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- Kimi-K3 decode on MI355X is latency-bound at small batches. Every MoE layer starts with the merged front GEMM (`shared gate-up | router | latent down`, N=6016, K=7168 at TP8).
- That GEMM goes through `F.linear`, so hipBLASLt picks the kernel. For this shape at 1-192 tokens its choice is slow; AITER's tuned BF16 table (ROCm/aiter#6411) has faster FlyDSL kernels.
- Goal: run the front through AITER's tuned GEMM where rows exist, as an opt-in switch, without touching other shapes or targets.

## Modifications

- `kimi_k3_rocm_moe.py`: `build_tuned_front_gemm` decides once, at weight-merge time, whether the tuned GEMM applies. Forward then checks only the token count.
- `KimiK3MoE._forward_fused` calls `tgemm.mm` for batches inside the window and keeps `_k3_bf16_gemm` otherwise.
- At load, the AITER row is checked for every batch size in the window (once per process), so a partial AITER cannot silently run untuned kernels.

| Env var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT` | `false` | Run the merged MoE front on AITER's tuned BF16 GEMM (needs `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`) |
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MIN_TOKENS` | `1` | Smallest batch (tokens) that takes the tuned GEMM |
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MAX_TOKENS` | `192` | Largest batch (tokens) that takes the tuned GEMM; AITER's last tuned row for this shape |

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Switch on, BF16 TP8 front (6016, 7168), gfx950 with 256 CUs, batch in window | AITER tuned GEMM |
| Batch outside the window | Default GEMM |
| Other TP size, dtype, arch, or CU count | Warning, default GEMM |
| `--enable-deterministic-inference` | Warning, default GEMM (AITER picks kernel and split-K by batch size) |
| AITER lacks `tgemm` or a tuned row for any batch in the window | Load fails with an error naming ROCm/aiter#6411 |
| `MIN_TOKENS > MAX_TOKENS` or `MIN_TOKENS < 1` | Load fails |

## Accuracy Tests

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| GSM8K, 1,319 questions, switch on, 3 runs | 97.19%, 97.42%, 97.12%; no truncation |
| GEMM max relative error vs FP32 | default 1.8e-3 to 3.6e-3; tuned 2.1e-3 to 6.8e-3 |

- GSM8K setup: Kimi-K3 integration build, TP8, DSpark block 3.

On/off on one recipe: `sgl-eval 0.1.3 run gsm8k --load-preset-from-model-id moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --num-threads 32` (full 1319, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, thinking on, reasoning_effort max).

| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT` | GSM8K runs | Truncated | Errors |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 1 (this PR) | 97.19%, 97.50% | 0 | 0 |
| 0 | 97.19% | 0 | 0 |

- All runs are within sampling noise (single-run stderr ~0.45 pp at temperature 1.0).
- Setup: 8x MI355X, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, AgentX c16 recipe (TP8/DCP8, HiCache, DSpark block 4, decode graphs bs 1-32), simulated acceptance off; only the switch differs. Build: `k3-agentx-pr-stack` @ `39d944c57d`, ROCm/aiter stack @ `f9b5308b2`.
- One earlier OFF run hung after 1215 answers (97.53% so far): every rank waited in `FutureMap.resolve_seq_lens_cpu` on an event that never fired, with the GPUs idle. The retry above did not hang, and no ON run hung, so the hang is on the default (switch off) path and not in this PR.
- Unit tests: `test/registered/unit/models/test_kimi_k3_rocm_quant.py` (CPU, fake AITER) and `test/registered/unit/models/test_kimi_k3_rocm_moe_gfx950.py` (real AITER on MI355X): 13 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Setup: 8x MI355X, TP8, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, integration build that includes other open K3 PRs.
- Workload: 8,192 input / 1,024 output tokens, radix cache off, 3 alternating runs per configuration.

| Concurrency | TPOT off (ms) | TPOT on (ms) | Change |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 13.43 | 12.86 | -4.2% |
| 4 | 15.83 | 15.25 | -3.7% |
| 8 | 18.55 | 18.00 | -3.0% |
| 16 | 23.43 | 23.54 | +0.5% |
| 32 | 31.78 | 31.51 | -0.8% |
| 64 | 47.12 | 45.92 | -2.5% |

- TPOT drops 2.5-4.2% at concurrency 1-8 and 64. Concurrency 16 is 0.5% slower in every run; concurrency 32 is within noise. TTFT is unchanged.
- GEMM microbenchmarks: 6-49% lower latency on the sampled tuned batches. M=160 had no tuned row in the AITER used for the microbenchmark and showed no gain. Some of the larger gains come from poor default kernel choices.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+# ==============================================================================
+"""Kimi-K3 ROCm dispatch for the merged MoE front GEMM.
+
+``KimiK3MoE`` builds a ``TunedFrontGemm`` once after merging its front weight,
+and runs its own BF16 GEMM when there is none or the batch is outside the window.
+"""
+
+import functools
+from typing import Callable, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import unquant
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import print_warning_once
+
+# Merged MoE front [shared gate-up | router | latent down] at TP8; other TPs differ.
+# Only this shape has tuned bf16 rows (ROCm/aiter#6411, gfx950 with 256 CUs only).
+_TUNED_FRONT_SHAPE = (6016, 7168)
+_TUNED_FRONT_TARGET = ("gfx950", 256)
+
+
+class TunedFrontGemm:
+    """AITER tuned BF16 GEMM for front batches within an inclusive token window."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, mm: Callable, min_tokens: int, max_tokens: int) -> None:
+        self._mm = mm
+        self._min_tokens = min_tokens
+        self._max_tokens = max_tokens
+
+    def covers(self, num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+        return self._min_tokens <= num_tokens <= self._max_tokens
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self._mm(inp=x, weights=weight, otype=x.dtype)
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _first_untuned_tokens(*, n: int, k: int, min_tokens: int, max_tokens: int):
+    """First batch size in the window with no tuned bf16 row, or None."""
+    from aiter.tuned_gemm import get_GEMM_A16W16_tuned_config
+
+    for m in range(min_tokens, max_tokens + 1):
+        config = get_GEMM_A16W16_tuned_config(
+            M=m,
+            N=n,
+            K=k,
+            bias=False,
+            dtype=str(torch.bfloat16),
+            otype=str(torch.bfloat16),
+        )
+        if config is None:
+            return m
+    return None
+
+
+def build_tuned_front_gemm(*, weight: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[TunedFrontGemm]:
+    if not (
+        envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.get() and envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT.get()
+    ):
+        return None
+    try:
+        from aiter.jit.utils.chip_info import get_cu_num, get_gfx
+        from aiter.tuned_gemm import tgemm
+    except ImportError as e:
+        raise ImportError(
+            "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT=1 needs aiter.tuned_gemm.tgemm and "
+            "get_GEMM_A16W16_tuned_config, which this AITER build lacks."
+        ) from e
+
+    if unquant._skip_aiter_unquant:
+        print_warning_once(
+            "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT is ignored with deterministic "
+            "inference: AITER picks the kernel and split-K by batch size."
+        )
+        return None
+    shape, target = tuple(weight.shape), (get_gfx(), get_cu_num())
+    if (
+        weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or shape != _TUNED_FRONT_SHAPE
+        or target != _TUNED_FRONT_TARGET
+    ):
+        print_warning_once(
+            "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT is set but only covers a bf16 "
+            f"{_TUNED_FRONT_SHAPE} front (TP8) on {_TUNED_FRONT_TARGET}; got "
+            f"{weight.dtype} {shape} on {target}, keeping the default GEMM."
+        )
+        return None
+    min_tokens = envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MIN_TOKENS.get()
+    max_tokens = envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MAX_TOKENS.get()
+    if not 1 <= min_tokens <= max_tokens:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_{MIN,MAX}_TOKENS must satisfy "
+            f"1 <= MIN <= MAX; got {min_tokens}, {max_tokens}."
+        )
+    # Without its tuned rows tgemm silently falls back to a default kernel.
+    untuned = _first_untuned_tokens(
+        n=shape[0], k=shape[1], min_tokens=min_tokens, max_tokens=max_tokens
+    )
+    if untuned is not None:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT=1 but this AITER has no tuned bf16 GEMM "
+            f"row for M={untuned}, N={shape[0]}, K={shape[1]} on {target}; it needs "
+            "ROCm/aiter#6411, whose rows cover 1-192 tokens."
+        )
+    return TunedFrontGemm(mm=tgemm.mm, min_tokens=min_tokens, max_tokens=max_tokens)

+"""Real-AITER check of the Kimi-K3 tuned MoE front GEMM on gfx950.
+
+The CPU tests in ``test_kimi_k3_rocm_quant.py`` fake ``tgemm.mm``;
+only this file checks the keywords ``TunedFrontGemm`` passes to AITER and its output.
+"""
+
+import os
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.models.kimi_k3 import _k3_bf16_gemm
+from sglang.srt.models.kimi_k3_rocm_moe import (
+    _first_untuned_tokens,
+    build_tuned_front_gemm,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=20, stage="stage-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+# TP8 merged front [shared gate-up | router | latent down], the only tuned shape.
+_FRONT_N, _FRONT_K = 6016, 7168
+# Inside the default window; its tuned row is a split-K kernel, the noisiest one.
+_IN_WINDOW_M = 64
+_LAST_TUNED_M = 192
+# Measured 4e-3..8e-3 over 5 seeds on AITER 285579b62, from bf16 output rounding;
+# a transposed weight gives ~1.5.
+_MAX_REL_ERR = 2e-2
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_hip(), "AITER's tuned front rows are gfx950 only")
+class TestTunedFrontGemmGfx950(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        from aiter.jit.utils.chip_info import get_gfx
+
+        if get_gfx() != "gfx950":
+            raise unittest.SkipTest("AITER's tuned front rows are gfx950 only")
+        gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        cls.weight = (
+            torch.randn(_FRONT_N, _FRONT_K, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.02
+        ).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        cls.x = torch.randn(_IN_WINDOW_M, _FRONT_K, device="cuda", generator=gen).to(
+            torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        # Default window; the build probes AITER's row for every batch size in it.
+        with (
+            patch.dict(os.environ),
+            envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.override(True),
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT.override(True),
+        ):
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MIN_TOKENS.clear()
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MAX_TOKENS.clear()
+            cls.tuned = build_tuned_front_gemm(weight=cls.weight)
+
+    def test_matches_the_default_bf16_gemm_inside_the_window(self):
+        self.assertIsNotNone(self.tuned)
+        self.assertTrue(self.tuned.covers(_IN_WINDOW_M))
+
+        out = self.tuned(self.x, self.weight)
+        ref = _k3_bf16_gemm(self.x, self.weight)
+
+        self.assertEqual(out.dtype, torch.bfloat16)
+        self.assertEqual(out.shape, ref.shape)
+        rel_err = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs().max() / ref.float().abs().max()
+        self.assertLess(rel_err.item(), _MAX_REL_ERR)
+
+    def test_default_window_is_tuned_up_to_its_last_batch(self):
+        """tgemm silently runs an untuned kernel for a batch without a row; the
+        default window must end at AITER's last tuned front row (M=192)."""
+        self.assertTrue(self.tuned.covers(_LAST_TUNED_M))
+        self.assertFalse(self.tuned.covers(_LAST_TUNED_M + 1))
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            _first_untuned_tokens(
+                n=_FRONT_N, k=_FRONT_K, min_tokens=1, max_tokens=_LAST_TUNED_M
+            )
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Unit tests for srt/models/kimi_k3_rocm_{quant,moe} and the K3 weight-merge guard."""
 
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
+import sys
+import types
 import unittest
 from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
 
 import torch
 
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import unquant
 from sglang.srt.models.kimi_k3 import _is_unquantized_mergeable
+from sglang.srt.models.kimi_k3_rocm_moe import (
+    _first_untuned_tokens,
+    build_tuned_front_gemm,
+)

 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
@@ -94,5 +103,97 @@ def test_rejects_float32(self):
         self.assertFalse(_is_unquantized_mergeable(weights))
 
 
+def _shaped(rows: int, cols: int, dtype=torch.bfloat16) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Only shape and dtype are read; expand keeps the 6016x7168 front at one element.
+    return torch.zeros(1, dtype=dtype).expand(rows, cols)
+
+
+def _fake_aiter(*, gfx: str = "gfx950", cu_num: int = 256, rows_up_to=192) -> dict:
+    tuned_gemm = types.ModuleType("aiter.tuned_gemm")
+    tuned_gemm.tgemm = SimpleNamespace(mm=lambda **kwargs: None)
+    tuned_gemm.get_GEMM_A16W16_tuned_config = lambda *, M, **kwargs: (
+        {"libtype": "flydsl"} if M <= rows_up_to else None
+    )
+    chip_info = types.ModuleType("aiter.jit.utils.chip_info")
+    chip_info.get_gfx = lambda: gfx
+    chip_info.get_cu_num = lambda: cu_num
+    return {
+        "aiter": types.ModuleType("aiter"),
+        "aiter.tuned_gemm": tuned_gemm,
+        "aiter.jit": types.ModuleType("aiter.jit"),
+        "aiter.jit.utils": types.ModuleType("aiter.jit.utils"),
+        "aiter.jit.utils.chip_info": chip_info,
+    }
+
+
+class TestTunedFrontGemm(CustomTestCase):
+    """AITER has tuned rows for one bf16 front shape (TP8) on gfx950 only;
+    the builder declines every other target, and a broken AITER fails the load."""
+
+    def _build(
+        self,
+        *,
+        use_aiter=True,
+        enabled=True,
+        weight=None,
+        aiter=None,
+        window=(48, 192),
+        deterministic=False,
+    ):
+        _first_untuned_tokens.cache_clear()
+        with (
+            patch.dict(sys.modules, _fake_aiter() if aiter is None else aiter),
+            patch.object(unquant, "_skip_aiter_unquant", deterministic),
+            envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.override(use_aiter),
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT.override(enabled),
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MIN_TOKENS.override(window[0]),
+            envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_TUNED_MOE_FRONT_MAX_TOKENS.override(window[1]),
+        ):
+            return build_tuned_front_gemm(
+                weight=_shaped(6016, 7168) if weight is None else weight
+            )
+
+    def test_covers_the_inclusive_env_window(self):
+        tuned = self._build()
+        for num_tokens, covered in ((47, False), (48, True), (192, True), (193, False)):
+            with self.subTest(num_tokens=num_tokens):
+                self.assertIs(tuned.covers(num_tokens), covered)
+
+    def test_declines_outside_the_tuned_target(self):
+        no_aiter = {"aiter": None, "aiter.tuned_gemm": None}
+        for name, kwargs in (
+            ("SGLANG_USE_AITER off", dict(use_aiter=False, aiter=no_aiter)),
+            ("switch off", dict(enabled=False, aiter=no_aiter)),
+            ("TP4 front shape", dict(weight=_shaped(7552, 7168))),
+            ("fp16 front", dict(weight=_shaped(6016, 7168, torch.float16))),
+            ("gfx942", dict(aiter=_fake_aiter(gfx="gfx942"))),
+            # A partitioned gfx950 has fewer CUs, and AITER keys rows on the CU count.
+            ("gfx950 with 32 CUs", dict(aiter=_fake_aiter(cu_num=32))),
+            # AITER picks the kernel and split-K by batch size.
+            ("deterministic inference", dict(deterministic=True)),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(name):
+                self.assertIsNone(self._build(**kwargs))
+
+    def test_fails_at_load_on_an_aiter_without_tgemm_or_its_rows(self):
+        without_tgemm = {**_fake_aiter(), "aiter.tuned_gemm": None}
+        with self.assertRaises(ImportError):
+            self._build(aiter=without_tgemm)
+        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
+            self._build(aiter=_fake_aiter(rows_up_to=0))
+
+    def test_fails_at_load_when_the_window_runs_past_the_tuned_rows(self):
+        """tgemm runs an untuned default kernel for a batch without a row, so a
+        window that only its smallest batch probes would pass a partial AITER."""
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "M=193"):
+            self._build(window=(1, 256))
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "M=65"):
+            self._build(aiter=_fake_aiter(rows_up_to=64), window=(1, 192))
+
+    def test_rejects_an_empty_window(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            self._build(window=(64, 32))
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
